content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], thank you for always providing helpful information. You shared a video a couple of years ago about transferring the [product_name] project to AWS, which used an older AWS version. I followed the steps from the video but couldn’t get it to work. Have there been changes to AWS since then, or could the issue be related to the region settings? Thanks for your continued support.

Hello, I am experiencing the same problem. It appears the current workaround for publishing from [product_name] to AWS is not effective anymore. Is there a new solution available? Thank you in advance.

analysis.insight_summary: Multiple users are having trouble transferring or publishing their [product_name] projects to AWS, based on instructions that referenced older AWS versions. The previous method no longer works, leading to frustration and questions about AWS updates or region configuration changes impacting compatibility. This is a common issue among several users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a simple, up-to-date process to publish [product_name] projects to AWS, ideally one that accounts for any recent changes made to AWS.
